top_refinement_prompt:
Make one tiny geometry correction to this approved game card asset.
Change ONLY the top edge: its current deep concave dip between the upper corners should become a very shallow, nearly straight dip. Raise the middle of the top stone rim so the center is only about 10 pixels lower than the corner shoulders on this 1024px-wide image, rather than the current roughly 70px drop. Keep a very subtle gentle curve; not perfectly ruler-straight.
Keep every other aspect unchanged: the two upper corner stones, left and right sides, bottom edge, muted stone colors, matte painted shading, small chips, border thickness, dark blank center, outer silhouette below the top region, overall width and height. Extend the existing dark center upward only as required beneath the lifted top rim.
True transparent alpha outside, opaque dark center inside. NO new texture, ornaments, lettering, imagery, color change or lighting change. Preserve the approved stone painting closely.
prompt:
Create a SINGLE empty playable card body following the Hearthstone discovery cards in the supplied screenshot, with no characters or text. This is a CARD, not a window frame: copy the small stone card slab material and slim chipped gray stone rim visible around the three minion cards. Do NOT reuse a large brown menu frame.
Portrait 2:3 canvas, true transparent alpha outside. A vertical rounded rectangular dark warm-gray stone card slab, compact slightly irregular chipped corners, subdued shallow edge thickness, understated hand-painted planes. Its rim is narrow (about 4% width), gray with warm tan upper edges and dark charcoal underside. The center is fully OPAQUE dark neutral slate-brown (#383531), uniform and calm. No grain or noisy texture. The object should have the scale and weight of a hand-held Hearthstone card. Keep the source's painterly muted stone material and broad sculpted light.
For production layering omit the illustration, oval portrait frame, title ribbon, parchment text area, attack/health medallions and star badge; these are separate live components. The output is ONLY the foundational blank stone slab of that card, flat calm surface for those layers. Do not replace it with a metallic window border or furniture.
One complete front-facing card body, fills 96% canvas, parallel sides suitable for nine-slice. No text, symbols, emblem, gold trim, rivets, neon, glow or additional ornament. Every pixel INSIDE the stone slab must be opaque including center; only its outside is transparent.
alphaEditPrompt: Edit this single card asset only to remove the entire background OUTSIDE the stone slab. Output true transparent alpha beyond its outer silhouette. Keep the slate stone body, center, shape, painting, dimensions and colors unchanged. The entire interior of the card including its blank center must stay fully opaque, alpha 255. Remove every brown backdrop and ambient halo outside. No added objects, text, new frame, texture, lighting changes or checkerboard drawing. Transparent-background isolated game asset.
usage: Only hero/offer card substrate; never window, tooltip, stat cell or equipment socket.
